known_limitations: Customer Growth and Growth Velocity have cited the identical underlying growth-event series in every tested instance where both were scoreable (Shopify, Dollar Shave Club, Peloton, Lemonade -- 4/4). Flagged for a future dimension-definition review; dimension architecture was explicitly out of scope for this calibration program and was NOT changed to address this.

Enterprise SaaS growth, consumer growth, and deeptech/partnership growth anchor families remain completely untested by any company examined across the full 19-company program (15 calibration + 4 targeted expansion).

Revenue Growth has zero scored examples across all 19 companies examined -- every candidate series either used non-comparable metrics, was a projection rather than a confirmed actual, or lacked a second comparison point entirely.

Evidence Independence Metadata (Part 15, item 6 of the specification) is a specification-level rule only -- no aggregation code in this repository currently computes independent_coverage_pct, effective_independent_dimensions, or the semantic-duplication tag. Implementation is future, separately-authorized work.

Traction pillar coverage remains low across the 15-company calibration set (score-bearing for 3/15 companies even after all anchor work); Financial Health remains suppressed for 10/15. Both are evidence-availability limitations of this specific historical portfolio, not defects in the pillars themselves -- Financial Health was the single sharpest discriminator of any pillar wherever it was actually available (PASS B finding).
